“你是个战士。而战士，只有在战场上才能算是真正的战士。”米先生淡淡地道，“其实我们选择你，也有其他方面的考虑。你的社会关系简单，除了你爷爷之外没有什么亲人了。即便是真正出了什么意外，也没有人会追究。”
“你说的意外，是像你这样残废了，还是根本就把命送掉？”林锐看着米先生道。
“一切都有可能。”米先生平静地道，“不过你放心，即便是你意外身故，我们也会负责到底。如果你死于战场，公司会给你的账户打上一笔钱，足够你爷爷养老。如果你活着完成了我们的合约，当然更是皆大欢喜。”
林锐沉默了很久，才缓缓站起来，他收起了桌上的那份合同，看着米先生道，“我需要再考虑考虑。”
“这是一个足以影响你命运的决定，我也希望你考虑清楚。不过别太久，你知道机会稍纵即逝。错过了，就永远不会再来了。我很期待我们能够成为同僚。”米先生看着林锐一笑，把一张名片递给他。“考虑好了，给我电话。”
林锐没有说什么，只是拿着那份合同安静地离开了。
米先生站在窗口看着楼下林锐孤独的背影渐行渐远，眼神平静得如同一潭死水。他很少看错人，他已经知道这个年轻人会考虑他的话，甚至会应下这份工作。他沉默地拿出了一支烟，却没有抽，只是放在鼻子前闻了闻。
有人走近了这间办公室，来的人大概三十多岁，头发剪得很短，穿着一件黑色的大衣。他看着米先生微微一笑道，“你似乎很在意这个年轻人，他有什么特别么？”
“每一个人都很特别，虽然他们身上有着很多类似的地方，但是从严格的意义上来说，每个人都是独一无二的。你很特别，他自然也不例外。”米先生没有回过头，似乎知道问他话的这个人是谁。
“嘿，你这话好像在故意掩饰什么。”那个人笑了笑，走到他的身边，拿出了打火机点着了凑上去。
米先生叹了一口气，吹灭了火焰，摇摇头道，“我戒了。”
“我没听错吧？公司的传奇人物，叱咤佣兵界的银狼米歇尔居然都已经戒烟了，这个世界真疯狂。看来你是刻意要和以前的生活一刀两断了啊。”那人耸耸肩道。
“总有一天，你也会像我一样退下来，走进公司的管理层，有新的生活。没有那一身满是汗味的迷彩服，没有血腥味，甚至没有硝烟的味道，取而代之的是西装革履，办公室，咖啡杯。人要生存，就必须融入环境。这就是我现在必须面对的环境。”米先生平静地道。
“等我活到那一天再说吧。”那个穿着黑色大衣的人笑了笑道。
“赵建飞，我让你办的事情怎么样了？”米歇尔看着那个人。
那个黑色大衣的人点点头道，“办妥了，新招收的一共十五人，是来自全国各地。我亲自考察过，有不少好苗子。一个月之后，他们将会被送往训练营。我们有正规的合同，走正规的出国劳务签证。不过，刚才那个小伙子，他似乎还没有确定下来。”
“他不是你需要担心的问题，我不会看错人，他是会来的。”米歇尔淡淡地道。
林锐回到了家，已经过了平常的饭点，他也已经来不及做饭，只是在路上顺便买了几个馒头。回家之后，他走进了爷爷的房间。老人似乎根本没有察觉到他回来了，只是痴痴呆呆地看着窗外。
林锐走到他身边，拿起了馒头递给他。“吃饭了，爷爷。”
“吃饭……”老人呆滞地转过身，用机械的声音重复着他的话。

“是的，该吃饭了。”林锐笑了笑道，“馒头是刚出笼的，买的时候还是热的，现在都还是温的。你坐着慢慢吃，我去烧点开水。”
“儿子，你回来了？不知道小锐吃饭了没有，要不然你给他送去？”老人颤巍巍地道。他并不认识林锐了，这几天一直把孙子当成儿子。他的记忆一片混乱，很多时候还是停留在几年前。
“爷爷，我就是小锐。”林锐勉强笑了笑。内心却是一片苦涩，谁能想到，现在这个连意识都不清楚的老人，曾经得过全国武术的冠军。年轻的时候，凭着一身好拳脚，寻常几个人都没法近他身。可是现在，他连低头穿鞋都有些困难。

content_en:
"You are a warrior. And a warrior can only be considered a true warrior on the battlefield." Mr. Mi said calmly, "Actually, we have other considerations in choosing you. Your social relationship is simple, and you have no relatives except your grandfather. Even if there is an accident, no one will pursue it."
"The accident you are talking about, are you crippled like you, or did you lose your life at all?" Lin Rui looked at Mr. Mi and said.
"Everything is possible." Mr. Mi said calmly, "But don't worry, even if you die unexpectedly, we will be responsible to the end. If you die on the battlefield, the company will add a sum of money to your account, enough for your grandfather to support him in his old age. If you live to complete our contract, of course everyone will be happy."
Lin Rui was silent for a long time before slowly standing up. He put away the contract on the table, looked at Mr. Mi and said, "I need to think about it again."
"This is a decision that can affect your destiny, and I hope you think about it carefully. But don't take too long. You know that the opportunity is fleeting. If you miss it, you will never come back again. I look forward to us becoming colleagues." Mr. Mi looked at Lin Rui, smiled, and handed him a business card. "Think about it and give me a call."
Lin Rui didn't say anything, just took the contract and left quietly.
Mr. Mi stood at the window and watched Lin Rui's lonely back downstairs drifting away, his eyes as calm as a pool of stagnant water. He rarely misjudged people, and he already knew that the young man would consider his words and even accept the job. He silently took out a cigarette, but did not smoke it. He just put it in front of his nose and smelled it.
Someone approached this office. The person was probably in his thirties, his hair was cut very short, and he was wearing a black coat. He looked at Mr. Mi and smiled slightly, "You seem to care about this young man. Is there anything special about him?"
"Everyone is special. Although they have many similarities, in a strict sense, everyone is unique. You are special, and he is no exception." Mr. Mi did not look back, as if he knew who the person who asked him was.
"Hey, you seem to be trying to hide something." The man smiled, walked to him, took out a lighter and lit it.
Mr. Mi sighed, blew out the flame, shook his head and said, "I quit."
"Did I hear you correctly? The company's legend, Michelle, the most powerful silver wolf in the mercenary world, has actually given up smoking. This world is so crazy. It seems that you are deliberately breaking off from your previous life." The man shrugged.
"One day, you will retire like me, step into the company's management, and have a new life. There will be no sweaty camouflage uniforms, no smell of blood, or even the smell of gun smoke. Instead, there will be suits and ties, an office, and a coffee cup. To survive, people must integrate into the environment. This is the environment I have to face now." Mr. Mi said calmly.
"Let's wait until I live to see that day." The man in the black coat smiled.
"Zhao Jianfei, how did the thing I asked you to do go?" Michelle looked at the man.
The man in the black coat nodded and said, "It's done. There are fifteen new recruits from all over the country. I have personally inspected and there are many good prospects. In a month, they will be sent to the training camp. We have a formal contract and a formal overseas labor visa. However, it seems that the young man just now has not been confirmed yet."
"He is not a problem you need to worry about. I will not misjudge the person. He will come." Michelle said calmly.
Lin Rui returned home. It was past the usual meal time and he had no time to cook. He just bought a few steamed buns on the way. After returning home, he walked into his grandfather's room. The old man didn't seem to notice that he was back at all, just looking out the window in a daze.
Lin Rui walked to him, picked up the steamed bun and handed it to him. "It's time to eat, Grandpa."
"Eat..." The old man turned around dully and repeated his words in a mechanical voice.
"Yes, it's time to eat." Lin Rui smiled and said, "The steamed buns were just out of the cage. They were still hot when I bought them, and they are still warm now. You sit down and eat slowly, and I will boil some water."
"Son, are you back? I wonder if Xiao Rui has eaten yet, or why don't you bring it to him?" the old man said tremblingly. He doesn't know Lin Rui anymore and has been treating his grandson as his son these days. His memory was a mess, and many times it was still stuck on a few years ago.
"Grandpa, I am Xiao Rui." Lin Rui forced a smile. But his heart was full of bitterness. Who would have thought that this old man who was not even aware of his consciousness had once won the national martial arts championship. When he was young, with his good fists and kicks, few people could get close to him. But now, it is difficult for him to even lower his head to put on his shoes.
